column1: # vendored-skills.tsv — the files this repo vendors from karlkfi/claude-skills,
# and the digests that hold them (Q890).
# Read by scripts/ci/check-vendored-skills.sh, which backs `make
# vendored-skills-check`. One row per vendored file; `#` and blank lines are
# ignored. Columns are tab-separated:
#   local_path        where the file lives here
#   upstream_path     its path in karlkfi/claude-skills
#   vendored_at       the upstream commit the file was taken from
#   vendored_sha256   what the upstream file hashed to at that commit
#   local_sha256      what the file in this tree must hash to now
# The two digests answer different questions. `vendored_sha256` records what
# was adopted, so a re-vendor can diff upstream forward from a known point.
# `local_sha256` is the one the gate asserts: a fork of a vendored file has to
# be declared here to land, which is the hold Q890 asked for. Equal digests
# mean an unmodified vendor; unequal means a declared local edit, and
# `--report` names which is which.
# The gate is local by construction and cannot see upstream. karlkfi/claude-
# skills is private, so a fetching gate needs a token this repo does not carry,
# and testing.md § the doc-links oracle rules the network out of `make check`
# anyway. Whether upstream has moved is therefore still unasked here; see
# docs/development/parallel-dispatch.md § Vendored from the skills repo.
# Adding a fifth vendored file needs a row added by hand. Nothing derives this
# set, because nothing in the tree marks a file as vendored.
